name: Angus McLeod
bio:
Angus McLeod's motorsport journey began in his youth, tinkering with go-karts in his backyard shed in rural Victoria. A fascination with optimizing performance led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, after which he immediately sought a role in motorsport. He spent several years in lower formulas honing his skills in data analysis and race strategy, before making the leap to Formula 1.

As a strategist, Angus is known for his meticulous preparation and his ability to quickly adapt to changing circumstances on the track. He emphasizes a data-driven approach, combined with an understanding of driver behavior and track conditions. His colleagues know him as calm and collected under pressure, a trait he attributes to his experience in high-stakes racing environments. Angus is distinctive for his uncanny ability to predict pit stop timings with remarkable accuracy, often giving his team a crucial edge.

Before joining Haas F1 team he had been working for Sauber for the last 10 years.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Angus is of average height with a slightly stocky build, often seen wearing his signature racing team polo.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with hand-written race simulations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rapidly against the table when deep in thought.
Insists on having a cup of strong black coffee exactly 30 minutes before each race.
